name: The majority voted in favour of a motion "*that Senate amendment (1) be disagreed to*", which means the amendment will not be agreed to. ### Text of Senate amendment (1) > *(1) Schedule 1, item 1, page 3 (before line 8), before section 3UL, insert:* > > *3ULA Expiration of this Division* > > *This Division is repealed at the start of the day after the end of the period of 4 years beginning on the day the Crimes Legislation Amendment (Police Powers at Airports) Act 2019 commenced.*
